description: This file contains the implementation of email-related services for the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for sending emails directly, from URLs, or rendered from screen templates, as well as handling multipart messages and email failures.

classes.name: EmailServices.StringDataSource
classes.description: A DataSource implementation that creates a string resource in memory for email attachments.

classes.name: EmailServices.ByteArrayDataSource
classes.description: A DataSource implementation that creates a byte array resource in memory for email attachments.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Main service for sending an email with support for multiple content types and attachments.

methods.name: sendMailFromUrl
methods.description: Service that retrieves email body content from a URL and sends an email.

methods.name: sendMailFromScreen
methods.description: Generates email content from screen templates and optionally creates attachments, then sends the email.

methods.name: sendMailHiddenInLogFromScreen
methods.description: Same as sendMailFromScreen but with the result hidden in log for security.

methods.name: sendFailureNotification
methods.description: Sends email notifications when delivery fails to specified addresses.
